pending: ITEM 1 - SETTLE THE H3 t2v FAILURE. `node scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs --retry-failed --keep-volume --volume aghcuvg7nl`, and CAPTURE THE POD'S COMFYUI LOG. Two candidates fit the same evidence and they need different fixes: (a) the drain-wait hole just fixed, or (b) ComfyUI dying and start.sh:193's supervisor relaunching it - h3-qwen3vl-32b-clip is 24.55GB on a 24GB L4 and the smoke budget shrinks the image, not the text encoder. An OOM line in the Pod log means the fix is VRAM-side (bigger card for H3's leg, or offload) and the guard fix is merely necessary, not sufficient. The failing op is always the FIRST H3 op, paying the cold load; i2v_ms and ref2v_ms pass warm right after.

ITEM 2 - THE USER-FACING HALF, uncarded and NOT yet fixed: when a prompt is destroyed mid-flight the app HANGS FOREVER. comfyController.js:1067 (`if (!entry) return; // not in history yet`) cannot tell 'not written yet' from 'destroyed', so the history poll spins and the promise never settles - frozen bar, no error, no toast, no log, and on a Pod the user is billed while watching a dead generation. The smoke runner ALREADY has the correct detection: gone from history AND queue AND comfyReady=true. Porting that into the app turns the hang into an actionable error REGARDLESS of which root cause in ITEM 1 wins. Fabio has seen this analysis; it needs a card and his call on the wording.

ITEM 3 - NOTES ACCURACY PASS before the freeze. UNRELEASED.md:176 says the new video previews need 'nothing extra to download' - wrong for an existing H3/LTX owner: taeh3-decoder (21.66MB) + ltx23-preview-taehv (22.44MB) are model deps, not engine assets, so ~22MB, or ~44MB if both models are owned. Suggested rewording: 'it arrives with the model'. UNRELEASED.md:460's 'Three files still have a single route' is CONFIRMED CORRECT as written - do not touch it (see the settled Krea 2 thread below).

ITEM 3b - RUN claim-auditor BEFORE folding UNRELEASED.md (peer message from MPI-511, message a8082e44, status acknowledged). It has NEVER run in this repo - zero hits across events.jsonl - because mpi-end-session section 7 says to run it without authorization language, so any session carrying 'Do not call the AgentTool unless the user requested it' skips it silently. On its first scoped run today it audited 21 claims over 3 commits and returned 1 FALSE, 0 OVERSTATED, 12 UNPROVABLE-FROM-GIT, 8 PROVEN. Dispatch mpi-kanban:claim-auditor over the commits behind each UNRELEASED.md entry BEFORE /mpi-version-bump folds it into RELEASE_NOTES['1.4.0']; it is read-only.

ITEM 4 - THEN the release chain, in this order: /mpi-version-bump -> 1.4.0, fold UNRELEASED.md into RELEASE_NOTES['1.4.0'] + docs/releases/2026-08-10-v1.4.0.md, release:check, release:approve --yes, CI artifacts (all three OS), THEN MPI-249's Linux leg on the real CubricVision-linux-x64-v1.4.0.tar.gz, THEN /mpi-release. The Linux leg CANNOT precede the bump+CI - it needs the real artifact. mpi-release's manifest stop reads dev 0.2.44 vs stable 0.2.40 - the answer is PROMOTE.

ITEM 5 - BOARD VIOLATION, not ours to fix: validate_board.py exits 1 with 'MPI-506/task.json is in doing but missing linked checklist.md'. MPI-506 belongs to a peer agent that moved it to doing this session. Ask before touching it.

key_decisions: SeedVR2 (MPI-506) and PiD-as-four-plugins (MPI-507) are DEFERRED TO 1.5 by Fabio and are NOT part of the 1.4 umbrella. Their agent moves those cards - do not move or repair them.

The H3 fix was deliberately NOT marked live-proven. That is exactly the mistake MPI-501 made: it sits in done/complete while its own validation.md still reads 'Not proven yet: the live half'. Do not close ITEM 1 on unit tests alone.

The full matrix was run instead of a subset because the runner refused to merge a scoped run into evidence describing an older engine. A subset would have left the file claiming a freshness 30 of its 35 rows did not have.

The pod repo's node_lock sync needed NO image rebuild: MpiNodes has installRequirements:false, so since MPI-222 it is volume-installed and the manifest-v2 drift check reinstalls it when the pin moves. The runner's own comment says so.

The Krea 2 single-route thread is CLOSED and was a false alarm on my side: mirrorUrl/noMirror being absent is the DESIGN for 31 deps that get a second route from the generic prefix rewrite in _mirrorUrlsFor. Checking dep FIELDS cannot see it; check the runtime. UNRELEASED.md:460 is true as written and adding a hand-written mirrorUrl would have broken the sweep-generated contract.

cleanup-orphans' `all` mode is opt-in and never automatic, because MPI-485 already has the name-filtered sweep reaping a peer session's live Pod - an indiscriminate version on a timer would be strictly worse.
constraints: POST /runpod/pods IS createPod AND RENTS A GPU. It is not a list. Use the new GET /runpod/pods. This trap fired on 2026-08-09 and AGAIN on 2026-08-10 and cost real money both times.

To clear strays now: GET /runpod/pods for the ids, then DELETE /runpod/pods/:id, or POST /remote/pod/cleanup-orphans {"all":true,"keepActive":false}. A plain cleanup-orphans only reaps pods named exactly 'cubric-vision'.
NEVER delete or shrink volume aghcuvg7nl (cubric-smoke, 450GB, EU-RO-1). Always --keep-volume.
cp dev_configs/smoke-run.txt BEFORE any smoke-workflows.mjs invocation - even --plan truncates it.
ROUTES DO NOT HOT-RELOAD. The app must be restarted before a routes/ change exists. Fabio restarted this session, so GET /runpod/pods IS live in his app now.

THE TREE IS SHARED. Commit by explicit pathspec only. comfy_workflows/** and tasks/MPI-504, MPI-506 are peer work and were deliberately left unstaged. NEVER git checkout -- / restore / stash / reset --hard / clean.

BASH: heredocs are hook-blocked - write a .py with the Write tool and run it by path. Backticks in a -m commit message get command-substituted by bash and silently eat words; use git commit -F <file>.
